purpose: Per-car absolute ranges for the 7 tune sliders whose min/max are chassis-specific (springs, ride height, downforce, final drive, gears). FH never prints the slider end-stops on screen, so these are learned by back-solving from >=2 known (normalized-position, displayed-value) points: value = min + norm*(max-min). Once a car+field has a solved range, EVERY on-disk tune for that car prints that field as an exact number instead of a slider position. Keyed by car ordinal. Written by hand and by the daemon (POST /tune-range). See research/savefile-decode-2026-08-22.md and fh6_tune_decode.py.
